༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bdud thams cad 'joms pa bzhugs so/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bdud thams cad 'joms pa bzhugs so// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs bdud thams cad 'joms pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la btud de/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba'i slad du yang / /gnas bsrung sa gzhi yongs gzung phyir/ /srung 'khor rgyas par bsgom pa'i tshul/ /rgyud las gsungs bzhin gsal bar bya/ /'di la sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum gyi dang po la/ kha lag dag pa'i cho ga sku gsung thugs ye shes sbyang ba/ lus la rigs drug dgod pa/ yan lag drug dgod pa'i cho ga zhing skyong dang / gnas mchod pa/ bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur bsgom pa/ bdud gzhom pa'i cho ga bgegs la phur bus gdab pa'o/ /dang po gnyis sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ las snang mtha' dkar po dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal can/ /g.yas tho ba/ mdung / rtse gsum pa/ g.yon pad dkar 'dab brgya/ me long / bgrang phreng / mgrin par āḥlas rin 'byung dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas me'i mda'/ rdo rje lcags kyu/ sgra bcas ḍā ma ru/ g.yon gzhu/ rdo rje zhags pa/ rin chen cha dgu pa/ snying gar hūm̐ las don grub nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ g.yas ral gri/ gri gug rtse gsum/ g.yon phub/ thod pa/ kha ṭāṃ ga dkar po/ lte bar ho las rnam snang ser po ser dkar nag pa'i zhal can/ g.yas 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ rdo rje gdengs pa/ g.yon dung / lcags sgrog sgra bcas dril bu/ gtsug tor du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa ljang dmar dkar ba'i zhal can/ /g.yas rdo rje/ gri gug dgra sta/ g.yon dril bu/ thod pa tshangs mgo gsang bar k+ṣaḥlas rdor sems sngon po sngo dmar dkar ba'i zhal can phyag mtshan snga ma dang 'dra bar bsgom mo/

/bzhi pa ni/ lag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis kyis snying gar reg ste/ oṃ hralīṃ hri da ma ya na maḥmago bor/ oṃ hūm̐ shi ra si swā hā/ gtsug tor du/ oṃ hṛṃ shi khā yi bau ṣaṭa/ yan lag thams cad la/ oṃ hrīṃ ka ba tsā ya hūm̐/ mig la/ oṃ hrām̐ ne trā ya wa ṣaṭa/ dge ba la g.yon/ mi dge ba la g.yas kyi mtheb mdzub kyis se gol gyis mtshon cha dgod cing / oṃ hrīḥ.astā ya phaṭa/ ces brjod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta hṛ da ya shi raḥshi kha ka ba tsa ni tra asta badz+ra sha ḍaṃ ga swa bhā wa āt+ma ko haṃ gis nga rgyal gzung ngo / /yang lte bar reg cing / /oṃ hralīṃ nā bh+yai na maḥsnying gar oṃ hūm̐ hṛ da yā ya swā hā/ mgrin par oṃ hṛṃ grī bā yai bau ṣaṭa/ dpral bar oṃ hrīṃ la lā ṭā ya hūm̐/ gtsug tor du oṃ hrī shi kha yai ba ṣaṭa/ gsang gnas su oṃ hrāḥgu h+ya ya phaṭa/ ces brjod do/ /lnga pa ni/ gtor ma gnyis 'og nas 'chad pa ltar byin gyis brlabs te/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgyas yul bdag gam/ zhing skyong spyan drang zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ che ge sa pa ri wa rī ya i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhu paṃ/ pra dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he sa pa ri wā raḥshī ghāṃ ā gats+tsha tu dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ.i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa tu/ khā da tu/ pi wa tu/ sa pa ri wā ra kaḥsarba sa twā nāṃ/ shān+tiṃ/ puṣ+ṭiṃ/ rak+ṣa wa ra ṇa/ gup+tiṃ ka ro tu i daṃ s+d+yā na/ t+yaka twā bā h+ye/ maṇ+ḍal bhu myaṃ tiṣ+ṭha tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra has ādz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ gtor ma dang po zhing skyong la phul te/ che ge'i gnas su yul lam grong gi ming yig mnyam pa'i thog mtha' dang / mi mnyam pa'i bar dang gsum bcug 'og ma la yang sbyar/ mthar bdud rtsis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sa 'di zhing skyong 'khor bcas la/ /gtor ma dri dang me tog spos/ /sgron ma 'bras bu ma nyams par/ /bcas 'di khyed la bdag 'bul gyis/ /'khor bcas myur du 'byon par mdzod/

/dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥgator ma 'di/ /bzung nas gsol zhing btungs mdzad de/ /'khor dang bcas pas sems can la/ /zhi dang rgyas shing bsrung ba dang / /bskyab dang sba bar mdzad du gsol/ /gnas 'di dor nas phyi rol du/ /dkyil 'khor sa gzhi la gnas mdzod/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa rdo rje 'dzin gyis/ /ji ltar bsgom bzhin mdzad swā hā/ /'di sa bzung ba'i dus su bya ste/ gzhan du oṃ daṃ nas tiṣ+ṭha'i bar dor la swas+d+ya naṃ gats+tsha gzhug cing / gnas 'di sogs rkang pa gnyis dor ro/ /khyi'i phyag rgyas grong dang gnas bdag spyan drangs shing / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshai ā gats+tsha shī gh+raṃ i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa bhuk+t+wa/ pi twa/ t-ip+tiṃ/ kṛtwa sar+b+bas twa nāṃ shān+tiṃ/ tsit+taṃ kri two a pa ras+d+yā naṃ gats+tsha gats+tsha swāhā/ gtor ma gnyis pa dbul/ bdud rtsis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ grong dang gnas bdag rnams myur du/ /tshur byon tshur byon gtor ma 'di/ /zung zhig bzung nas gsol ba dang / /'thungs te tshims par byas nas su/ /sems can rnams ni thams cad la/ /zhi ba'i sems su byas nas ni/ /'di las gzhan pa'i gnas nyid du/ /'byon zhing byon nas rgyas par mdzod/ /ces phrin las bcol te/ 'di yang sa gzung ba ma yin pa'i dus su/ /a pa ras+d+yā naṃ gyi gnas su swās+d+yā ni dang 'di sogs kyi gnas su/ rang nyid gnas pa'i gnyid du/ zhes gzhug cing gshegs su gsol/ drug pa ni/ dpral bar zla ba las/ oṃ las rdo rje dkar po rtse mo bcu bdun pa/ mgrin par nyi ma la āḥlas rdo rje dmar po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ snying gar sgra gcan nag po la hūm̐ las rdo rje nag po rtse mo dgu pa/ lte bar dus me ser po la ho las rdo rje ser po rtse mo drug cu rtsa lnga pa/ gtsug tor du nam mkha' ljang khu la haṃ las rdo rje ljang khu rtse mo lnga pa/ gsang bar ye shes sngon po la k+ṣa/ las rdo rje sngon po rtse mo sum cu rtsa gsum pa/ g.yon pa'i dpung pa'i rtsa la/

nga ngi ng-ir ngu ngil ngaṃ/ gha ghi ghṛ ghu ghl̥ gaṃ ga gi gri gu gl̥ gaṃ kha khi khṛ khu kh+li khaṃ/ ka ki kṛ ku kl̥ kaṃ ste thung ngu dang / g.yas pa'i rtsa la/ k+kāḥk+k-ilā k+kū+-i k+k-ir k+kī k+kāḥkh+khāḥkh+kh-ilāḥkh+khū kh+kh-irā kh+khī kh+khā/ g+gāḥg+g-ilā g+gū g+g-ir g+gī g+gā/ gh+gāḥgh+g-ilā gh+gū gh+g-irā gh+gī gh+gā/ d+dāḥd+dilā d+dū d+dṛ d+dī d+dā ste ring po las rdo rje ljang khu/ nye ba'i dpung pa g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa sde thung ring las rdo rje nag po mkhrig ma g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la/ ṭa sde thung ring las rdo rje/ dmar po/ dpyi g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la pa sde thung ring las rdo rje dkar po/ pus mo g.yon g.yas gyi rtsa la/ ta sde thung ring las rdo rje ser po/ long bu g.yon g.yas kyi rtsa la sa sde thung ring las rdo rje nag po rtse mo sum cu so gcig pa bcu gnyis dang / g.yon pa'i mthe chung nas mthe bo'i bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la/ nga ngi ngir ngu ng+li ngaṃ dang / de bzhin du gha ga kha ka rnams la sbyar ba dang / g.yas kyi mthe bong nas mthe'u chung gi bar gyi rtsa ba'i tshigs kyi rtsa la/ k+kāḥk+kir k+kū k+kil k+kī k+kā dang / de bzhin du kh+khāḥl sogs pa la sbyar ba las rdo rje ljang khu sor tshigs bar ma'i rtsa la/ tsa sde thung ring las rdo rje ljang khu nag po/ rtse mo'i tshigs kyi rtsa la ṭa sde thung ring las rdo rje dmar po/ rkang sor gyi rtsa tshigs kyi rtsa la pa sde thung ring las rdo rje dkar po/ bar tshigs kyi rtsa la ta sde thung ring las rdo rje ser po/ rtse mo'i tshigs kyi rtsa la sa sde thung ring las rdo rje sngon po ste/ drug cu po thams cad kyang rtse mo bdun pa'o/ /de bzhin du rna ba g.yon g.yas la a ā las rdo rje ljang khu/ sna bug g.yon g.yas la ye shes las rdo rje nag po/ mig g.yon g.yas la ar ār las rdo rje dmar po/ lce lce chung la au au las rdo rje dkar po/ gsang ba/

bshang lam la al āl las rdo rje ser po/ yid dang khu ba'i rtsa a wa dhū tī'i yas sna mas sna la am̐ aḥlas rdo rje sngon po rtse mo gsum pa'o/ /gtsug tor dang mgo bo ljang khu/ lce dang rkan la ya yā las rdo rje na ga po/ lag mthil g.yon g.yas la rā rā las rdo rje dmar po/ rkang mthil g.yon g.yas la wa wā las rdo rje dkar po/ bshang lam gyi g.yon g.yas su la la las rdo rje ser po rtse mo lnga pa dgod de/ de ltar bdag nyid rdo rje'i skur bsgom mo/ /bdun pa ni/ rdo rje de rnams las rang 'dra'i rdo rje rang rang gi kha dog dang mthun pa'i me 'bar ba ljang khu steng / sngon po 'og nag po shar dang shar lho dmar po lho dang lho nub/ dkar po byang dang byang shar/ ser po nub dang nub byang du spos pas phyogs bcur gnas pa'i bdud tshogs sems can la 'tshe ba rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bsregs nas thal bar gyur bar bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥhrāḥr ra ra ra/ badz+ra a na la sarba ā bar ṇa dharma la ya swa bhā wa sar+b+ba ma ra kā yi ka bigh+na bi nā ya ka ā dī nā da sha dika tā nāṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta ni da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bhasmiṃ ku ru ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa zhes brjod do/ /brgyad pa ni/ bdud bgegs log 'dren gzhan du bros pa dang ma tshig pa rnams/ rdo rje shugs kyi rdo rje'i lcags kyus bkug mi g.yo bas zhags pas bcings/ mtha' yas brtson 'grus kyis ha ya ra wa la thung ring las skyes pa'i rdo rje phur bu stod khro bo zhal drug phyag drug pa/ lte ba'i 'og mdung gi rtse mo'i rnam pas/ phyogs bcur bgegs kyi steng du btab par bsam zhing / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa badz+ra kī la kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na a dhi pa to ṣaṇ+mu kha ṣaṭa bhu dza ṣaṭa tsa ra ṇa sar+b+ba bigh+na bi nā ya kā di duṣ+ṭa nāṃ kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā nā ni kī la ya kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa zhes dang /

de nas dbyug sngon can gyi tho bas brdungs par bsam zhing / oṃ ll̥ḥbadz+ra mud+gā ra/ mā rā dī nāṃ/ shi ra si/ kaṇ+ṭhe/ hri da ye/ nāṃ bh+yo/ gu h+ye/ an+te/ badz+ra kī la kān ā ko ṭa ya/ ā ko ṭa ya k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣ-iṃ k+ṣ-iṃ kṝṃ kṛṃ k+ṣuṃ k+ṣuṃ k+ṣl̥ṃ k+ṣl̥ṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang ba'i bar phug gser gyi sa gzhi dang sbrags nas g.yo 'gul med cing bde ba chen po'i ror gyur par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rten bskyed pa/ brten pa bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba gsum gyi dang po ni/ dbus su/ hāṃ yāṃ rāṃ bāṃ lāṃ brtsegs pa bsams te/ oṃ hāṃ yāṃ rāṃ wāṃ lāṃ badz+ra ā kā sha wā yu te dza u da ka pṛ th+wi badz+ra swa bhā wa pañtsa dhā ta bo badz+ra maṇ+ḍa lā ni ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ haṃ las nam mkha'i rang bzhin chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po gzhu'i dbyibs can rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum nor bus mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po pad+mas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ so so'i steng 'og tu hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rjes brgyan par gyur pa gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ raḥ brtsegs par gyur/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ raḥbadz+ra tsan+d+ra sūr+ya rā hu kā la ag+na yeḥkā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta dz+nyā na badz+ra prā ka rā ṇa ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas nam mkha' dang sa sbyar ba zlum por snang ba'i mtshams na ra ba gsum dang / yul 'khor gyi mtshams su ra ba lnga dang / dbus su rdo rje'i sa yul 'khor gyi mthar thug pa dang / 'og tu mdung dang / steng du mda'i dra ba rnon pos khyab pa'i dbus su hūm̐ bsam zhing / oṃ hūm̐ bi shwa kā ya badz+ra ku ṭa gā raṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/

zhes pas de'i dbus su khang pa brtsegs pa steng 'og tu khru nyis brgya pa'i dbus su paḥbasam zhing / oṃ paḥbi shwa badz+ra pad+maṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas pad+ma 'dab brgyad khru bcu gnyis pa lte ba la khru bzhi yod pa'i steng du/ raḥbasam zhing oṃ raḥbadz+ra sūr+ya badz+ra sūr+yā sa nāṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ zhes pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lte ba dang mnyam pa dang / lha gzhan rnams kyi gnas su'ang rang rang gi gdan bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa la dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa gzhug rdo rje dgod pa/ dbang bskur ba/ rgyas gdab pa/ nga rgyal gzung ba'o/ /dang po la/ bdag nyid rdo rje shugs su bskyed nas nga rgyal gzung ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi sa dang slob ma bsrung phyir 'khor spro ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de'i steng du bdag nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po nag dmar dkar ba'i mgrin pa gsum dang / sngo dmar ser dkar ba'i zhal bzhi re re 'ang mche ba gtsigs shing 'jigs su rung ba dang ldan pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dmar ser du 'dug pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ mi bskyod pa'i cod pan can/ g.yas g.yon gyi phrag pa dang po nag gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa dkar/ kha dog de dang mtshungs pa'i dpung pa drug drug phyag nyer bzhi/ lhag ma gnyis g.yas nag g.yon ser ba/ phyag rnams kyi mthe bong ser/ mdzub mo dkar/ gung mo dkar/ ming med nag mthe'u chung ljang / sor mo rnams kyi tshigs dang po nag gnyis pa dmar/ gsum pa dkar/ sor gdub rnams mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba/ zhabs g.yas dmar/ g.yon dkar bas bdud 'dod lha dang / nyon mongs dbang phyug gi snying gar g.yas brkyangs bas mnan par bsgoms la phyag rgya dgod de/ so so'i sa bon las phyag rgya so sor gyur pa bkod par bsgoms la/ so so'i phyag rgya bca' zhing / oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kat+na yor badz+ra kuṇ+ḍa le hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis rna ba g.yon g.yas la rus pa las byas pa'i rdo rje'i rna rgyan/

de bzhin du mgo bor oṃ dang mthar hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa sbyar te/ aṃ aḥka ṭ+ya kaṇ+ṭhe badz+ra me kha lā badz+ra kaṇ+ṭhe ke sked mgul la ska rags mgul rgyan/ a ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor badz+ra ru tsa kaus phyag gdab/ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra ru tsa kaus phyag gdub/ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor badz+ra nū pu res zhabs gdub/ haṃ baṃ pañtsa ā kā ra ma hā shū n+yai swa bhā wa badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi si sar+b+baṃ ge bhasmas spyi bor nor bu dang lus la thal ba/ aṃ a ar+dha na rī shwa ra badz+ra ad+dha tsan+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ud+dhes mtshogs ma'i g.yon du zla phyed dang / dpral bar dar dpyangs/ a aḥ.aṃ sar+b+ba swa raika tri swa ra swa bhā ba badz+ra ya dz+nyo pa bī ta skan+dhes phrag par rdo rje mchod phyir bcings par bsam ste/ drug ni phar phyin drug dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du/ k+ṣaḥdur dān+tā bhī ma na k+ṣa yaṃ ka ra byā gh+ra tsarma ka ṭaus/ sked par stag lpags/ haṃ k+ṣaḥtriṃ shang swa ra swap+ta ti hra swa dīr+gha byañdza na swa bhā ba d+yai t+ya ku la sha ta shi ro bhirmuṇ+ḍa mā la kan+dha a ba laṃ bi ni kan+dhes phrag par bdud rigs brgya'i mgo phreng / ha hi hṛ hu hl̥ pañtsa kan+dha bi shu dha swa bhā ba shi ra si ka pā la mā les dbu re re la thod pa rdzogs pa kha dog lnga'i phreng ba ste/ glang lpags dang bcas pa bzhis phar phyin phyi ma bzhi dag pa ste/ gnas kyi dbye bas bcu drug ni/ /stong pa nyid bcu drug dag pa'o/ /de bzhin du g.yas kyi phyag nag po bzhir/ oṃ k+ṣ+raḥbadz+ra kro ngha badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa kyis khro bo'i rdo rje/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ khaḍ+gas ral gri/ tri shū laṃ gis rtse gsum/ kārta ris gri gug dmar po bzhir/ bā ṇas mda'/ aṃ ku shas lcags kyu/ ḍa ma ru kas ḍa ma ru/ muṅga ras tho ba/ dkar po bzhir/ tsakras 'khor lo/ kun+tas mdung / daṇ+ḍas dbyug pa/ par+shus dgra sta/ g.yon gyi nag po bzhir/ oṃ hwāṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ho phroṃ phaṭa kyis rdo rje dril bu/

de bzhin du sbyar la/ khe ṭa hos phub/ kha twāṃ gas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā las thod pa/ dmar po bzhir/ tsā pas gzhu/ pā shas zhags pa/ rat+nas rin po che/ pad+mas pad+ma/ dkar po bzhir/ shaṃ khas dung / ā dar+shas me long / shriṃ kha las lcags sgrog tsa turbe ta swa bhā ba brah+ma shi ros tshangs mgo gdong bzhi pa/ oṃ k+ṣa k+ṣā k+ṣi k+ṣī k+ṣ+r-i k+ṣṝ k+ṣu k+ṣū k+ṣl̥ k+ṣl̥̄ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣāṃḥ ha hā/ hi hī/ hṛ hṝ/ hu hū/ hl̥ hl̥/ haṃ haḥsar+b+ba bigh+na bi da ri ta ga dza tsarma pa ta a tra rak+ta shra bta hūm̐ phreṃ gis glang lpags rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa mgo g.yas su bstan te gyon pa'i rkang lag g.yon pa gnyis nas phyag tha ma gnyis kyis bzung ste 'phyar zhing sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra dza ya nā gen+d+ra badz+ra dza ṭa mu ku ṭa ban+dhe tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa kyis rgyal ba ljang khur ral pa'i cod pan/ de bzhin du mgo bor oṃ dang mthar tiṣ+ṭha la sogs sbyar te/ k+ṣuṃ badz+ra bi dza ya nā gin+d+ra badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ban+dhes/ rnam rgyal sngon pos dar dpyangs/ h+yaṃ h+yā badz+ra karko ṭa ka badz+ra pad+mau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kuṇ+ḍa la yoḥstobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos g.yon g.yas kyi rna rgyan/ hraṃ hra badz+ra bā su ki shaṃ kha pā lau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ru tsa ka yoḥnor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos g.yon g.yas kyi phyag gdub/ hwaṃ hwā badz+ra a nan ta ku li kau me kha lā kaṇ+ṭhi ka yoḥmatha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos ska rags mgul rgyan/ h+laṃ h+lāṃ badz+ra tak+ṣa ko ma hā pad+mau bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da nū pu ra yoḥ 'jog po dang pad+ma chen po ser pos g.yon g.yas kyi rkang gdub tu bcings par mos la oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti badz+ra sa two haṃ/ dud+dān+ta da ma ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swa hā/ zhes pas nga rgyal gzung ngo / /gnyis pa la/ khro bo/ zad par/ phyogs skyong / gza'/ klu/ 'byung po spro ba drug gi dang po ni/ snying gar nyi ma la hahā y+yā rarā w+wā l+lā brtsegs pa'i ha ha dang rdo rje las gtsug tor ljang khu mi bskyod pa dang /

hā dang rdo rje las gnod mdzes/ rdor sems lta bur gyur/ oṃ haṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza ma hā uṣ+ṇi ṣa ud+dha di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā dang / oṃ hāḥbadz+ra kro ha rā dza sum+bha a dho di shi rak+ṣaṃ ku ru ku ru swā hās bka' bsgos nas/ rtsa zhal gyi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung nas steng du khang brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba dang / 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhir nyi mar 'khod/ de bzhin du sngags kyi thog mtha' sbyar zhing / yi yī dang ral gri las bgegs mthar byed dang dbyug sngon don grub lta bur gyur/ yaṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dza a ti ba la sarbā bigh+nan+ta ka pūr+b+ba dang / yāḥbadz+ra kro ha rā dza nī la daṇ+ḍa ag+ne yaṃ gis bka' bsgos nas/ sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar du zla ba dang / mer nyi mar 'khod/ raṛ raṝ dang rin po che las shes rab mthar byed dang 'dod rgyal rin 'byung lta bur gyur/ raṃ badz+ra kroṃ dha rā dza dzam+bha ka duṣ+ṭa pra dz+nyān+ta ka dak+ṣi nai ri t+yaṃ gis bka' bsgos/ mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / byang du zla ba dang dbang ldan du nyi mar 'khod/ ll̥ ll̥̄ dang 'khor lo las gshin rje mthar byed dang stobs po che rnam snang lta bur gyur/ laṃ badz+ra kro dha rā dzi stam+bha ka ya mān+ta ka pash+tsi ma dang / lāḥbadz+ra kro ha rā dza ma hā ba la bā ya byaṃ gis bka' bsgos/ bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub tu zla ba dang rlung du nyi mar 'khod/ thams cad kyang skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul dang phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa g.yas brkyang gis gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying gar nyi mar/ ng+ngā ny+nyā ṇ+ṇā m+mā n+nā'i/ nga ngā dang rdo rje las zad par nam mkha' dang ye shes gnyis mi bskyod pa dang rdor sems 'dra ba/ rang gi rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / khang brtsegs kyi steng dang / gnod mdzes kyi 'og tu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/

nyī nyī dang ral gri las zad par rlung gnyis don grub 'dra ba/ sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ṇa ṇa ṛ ṇa ṇa ṝ dang rin po che las zad par me gnyis rin 'byung lta bu mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ mu mū dang pad+ma las zad par chu gnyis snang mtha' lta bu lce dang chu lam nas phyung / byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ na l̥ na l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las zad par sa gnyis rnam snang lta bu bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ thams cad kyang rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha'i gos can rin po ches brgyan pa ste de gnyis yid kyi khams bsrung ba'o/ /gsum pa ni/ snying ga'i nyi mar/ gh+gā dz+dzhā ḍh+ḍā bha bhā dha dhā'i gha dang khab las tshangs pa ljang khu zhal bzhi g.yas khab/ bgrang phreng / g.yon pad+ma/ spyi blugs ghā dang 'khor lo las khyab 'jug sngon po/ g.yas 'khor lo/ dbyug pa/ g.yon pad+ma/ skye ba lnga pa'i dus 'dzin pa/ rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / rab gsum gyi nang du rgya tshad dang mtshungs pa'i steng 'og tu ngang pa dang mkha' lding la 'khod/ dzhi dang ral gri las bden bral nag po/ g.yas ral gri/ gri gug g.yon phub/ thod pa/ dzhi dang dpag bsam gyi shing las/ rlung lha nag po/ g.yas dpag bsam shing / yongs 'du'i me tog g.yon in+d+ra nī la/ ut+pal sngon po can/ rna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer/ yi dwags dang ri dwags la 'khod/ ḍh-i dang dbyug pa las gshin rje dmar po g.yas dbyug pa/ ral gri/ g.yon lcags sgrog zhags pa/ ḍh+rī dang shag ti las me lha dmar po g.yas shag ti dbyug pa/ g.yon pad+ma/ spyi blugs can mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du ma he dang lug la 'khod/ bhu dang zhags pa las rgya mtsho dkar po g.yas zhags pa/ rin po che/ g.yon sbrul zhags/ chu shel/

bhū dang rtse gsum las drag po dkar po g.yas rtse gsum las drag po dkar po g.yas rtse gsum/ mda'/ g.yon kha ṭ+wāṃ ga sbrul bcas/ gzhu can lce dang chu lam nas phyung / byang dang dbang ldan du chu srin dang khyu mchog la 'khod/ dahl̥ dang rdo rje las dbang po ser po/ g.yas rdo rje/ me'i mda'/ g.yon dril bu/ gzhu/ dahl̥ dang be chon las gnod sbyin ser po/ g.yas rin po che/ be con g.yon ne'u le/ pad+ma can/ bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub dang rlung du glang po che dang gzhal yas khang la 'khod/ thams cad kyang phyag bzhi pa/ tshangs pa ma gtogs zhal gcig pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ snying gar nyi mar/ g+gā dz+dzā ḍ+ḍā b+bā d+dā'i ga dang khab las sgra gcan tshangs pa dang / gā dang 'khor lo las du me khyab 'jug lta bu rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / ra ba gsum gyi rgya tshad dang mnyam pa'i phyi rol gyi steng 'og tu stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ dzi dang ral gri las zla ba bden bral dang / dzī dang dpag bsam gyi shing las nyi ma rlung lha lta bu sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ dhṛ dang dbyug pa las lag pa gshin rje dang / ḍh+ṝ dang shag ti las mig dmar me lha lta bu mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ bu dang zhags pa las/ pa sangs chu lha dang / bū dang rtse gsum las phur bu drag po lta bu lce dang chu lam nas phyung / byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ dalī dang rdo rje las mjug ring dbang po dang / dalī dang be con las spen pa gnod sbyin lta bu/ bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas/ phyung / nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa ste/ de gnyis ngag gi khams bsrung ba'o/

/lnga pa ni/ snying gar nyi mar/ kh+khā tsh+tshā ṭha ṭhā pha phā tha thā'i/ kha khā dang bum pa las rgyal ba ljang khu dang rnam rgyal sngon po/ rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / ra ba lnga'i nang gi rgya tshad dang mnyam pa'i steng 'og tu nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ tshi tshī dang rgyal mtshan las stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag po sna g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ṭhṛ ṭh+rī dang nor bu las nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar po mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ phu phū dang pad+ma las mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar po lce dang chu lam nas phyung / byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ /thal̥ thal̥ dang rdo rje las pad chen dang 'jog po ser po bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ rgyal rnam rgyal la sbrul mgo bdun dang / gzhan rnams sbrul mgo lnga'i gdengs ka can/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas bum pa rdo rje/ g.yon pad+ma rin chen/ lha'i gos dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ rdo rje'i gdan gyi bzhugs pa'o/ /drug pa ni/ snying gar nyi mar/ k+kā ts+tsā ṭ+ṭā p+pā t+tā'i ka kā dang gri gug las ro lang ljang khu dang grul bum sngon po rna ba g.yon g.yas nas phyung / ra ba lnga'i phyi rol gyi rgya tshad dang mnyam pa'i steng 'og tu stong pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ rtsi dang gri gug las mi'am ci khyi'i gdong can dang / skyes bu'am ci bya rog gdong can nag po sna bug g.yon g.yas nas phyung / shar dang mer rlung gi dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ ṭaṛ ṭaṛ dang gri gug las dri za phag gdong can dang 'byung po bya rgod gdong can dmar po mig g.yon g.yas nas phyung / lho dang bden bral du me'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ pu pū dang gri gug las srin po stag gdong can dang / yi dwags 'ug gdong can dkar po lce dang chu lam nas phyung /

byang dang dbang ldan du chu'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ tal̥ tal̥̄ dang gri gug las brjed byed lce spyang gi gdong pa can/ mkha' lding mkha' lding nyid ser po bshang lam dang gtsug tor nas phyung / nub dang rlung du sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'khod/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ mgo phreng can/ zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa ste/ de gnyis ni lus kyi khams bsrung ba'o/ /de rnams ni khams drug dag pas khang brtsegs dang ra ba gnyis kyi phyi nang bsrung ba ste/ nang ma rnams zhal phyi dang / phyi ma rnams nang du gzigs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang / dzaḥzhes brjod/ rang las rang 'dra spros pas ye shes pa spyan drangs rang la bstims te mchod/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang hūm̐ gis shes rab mthar byed kyis gzhug zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang baṃ gshin rje mthar byed kyis dbyer med par bcing / dril bu'i phyag rgya dang hoḥpad+ma mthar byed kyis mnyes par byas/ dbyug pa'i phyag rgya dang / hi bgegs mthar byed kyis ro mnyam par byas par bsam mo/ /gsum pa ni/ sngar ltar rdo rje'i sa bon dgod pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ sgrub thabs ltar dbang bskur rgyas par blang ba'o/ lnga pa ni/ gtso bo dang steng gi lha rnams la mi bskyod pa/ shar dang shar lho la don grub/ lho dang lho nub la rin 'byung / byang dang byang shar la snang mtha'/ nub dang nub byang la rnam snang / 'og gi rnams la rdor sems sprul sku'i cha byad can gyis dbu brgyan par bsam mo/ /drug pa ni/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta rak+ṣaṃ tsakra swa bhā ba āt+ma ko3haṃ gis nga rgyal gzung bar bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ snying gar nyi mar rdo rje'i lte ba la/ hūm̐ la sngags phreng gis bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis thugs rgyud bskul/ byin gyis brlabs/ 'od kyis rnam par bsdus/ sngags phreng la thim/ 'od phyogs bcur 'phros/

bdud bgegs thams cad tshar bcad par bsam zhing / sngags don dran pas/ oṃ na mo badz+ra satwa ya/ na mo bud+dha bo dhi satwe bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra kro dh+yen+d+ra rā dze bh+yaḥn mo bi shwa mā tre/ na mo bud+dha bo dhi satwa de bī bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te kā la tsakrā ya/ badz+ra bhai ra ba bhī kā rā ya/ ma hen+d+ra ṇī la bdan+na sha rī rā ya/ mā ra kle sha hṛ da yā krān+ta si ta rak+ta tsa ra ṇā ya/ kriṣ+ṇa rak+ta si ta kaṇ+ṭha ya/ nī la si ta pī ta rak+ta daṃṣ+ṭ+ra ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya/ kṛṣ+ṇa rak+ta si ta sa bye ta raskan+dhā ya/ dwā da sha bhu dzā ya/ ṣaḍa biṃ sha ti ka rā ya/ badz+ra khaḍa ga tri shū la kāt+ti kā bā ṇa aṃ ku sha ḍa ma ru ka mud+gar tsakra kun+ta daṇ+ḍa par+ṭhu badz+ra ghan+ta khe ṭa kha ṭ+wāṃ ga ka pā la tsā pa pā sha rata sha ma laṃ shaṃ kha ā dar+sha shrīṃ kha la brah+ma shi ro ga dza tsar+m+ma dh+rik+ka rā ya/ byā gh+ra tsar+m+ma ṇi wa sa nā ya/ kan+dhe muṇ+ḍa mā lā ba laṃ bi ne/ shi ra si badz+ra paṭ+ṭa mu ku ṭaṃ badz+ra ka pā la mā la ad+dha tsaṇ+ṭa dha rā ya/ kuṇ+ḍa la ru tsa ka kaṇ+ṭhi kā me kha lā nū pu ra bhasma ya dz+nyo pa bī ta shi ro ma ṇi ma hā mu drā nā gen+d+ra bi bhū ṣa ṇā ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī san+to ṣi ta hṛ da yā ya/ in+d+ra ag+ni ya ma nai ri t+ya ba ru ṇa bā yu ku be ra ī sha na brah+ma biṣ+ṇu bi nā ya ka kar+t+ti ke ya nan di ma hā kā la gra ha nag ṣa tra k+ṣe tra pā la su ren+d+ra a su ren+d+ra pha ṇīn+d+ra byu ten+d+ra saṃ pū ta tsa ra ṇā ya/ zhes rkang pa bcu drug pa dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ ham̐k+ṣamalawarayakā la tsakra/ dur dan+ta da ma ka dzā ti dzā ra ma ra ṇān+ta ka trai lokya bi dza ya/ ma hā bī re shwa ra/ badz+ra bhai ra wa/ badz+ra kā ya/ badz+ra gā tra/ badz+re ne tra/ badz+ra sho tra/ badz+ra gh+ra ṇa/ badz+ra dzi hwā/ badz+ra dan+ta/ badz+ra na kha/ badz+ra ke sha badz+ra lo ma/ badz+ra ā bha ra ṇa/ badz+ra hā s+ya/ badz+ra gī ta/ badz+ra nrit+ya/ badz+ra yu dha ka ra/

badz+ra kro dha rā dza a dhi pa ti/ badz+ra ḍā ka badz+ra ḍā ki ni dzā la ya ri bri ta/ shī gh+raṃ ā gats+tsha ā gats+tsha/ badz+ra sa twa dz+nyā ya sar+b+ba mā ra bigh+na bi nā ya ki kaṃ na ra kiṃ pu ru ṣa ga ru ḍa gan+dharba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa bhū ta ma hā pre ta kum+bhaṇ+ḍa a pasmā rak+ṣe tra pā la be tā ḍa pū tā na duṣ+ṭa nā ga gra ha da yo ye sar+b+ba dz+wa ra sar+b+ba byā dhi k+ṣu dro pa dra ba kā ri ṇaḥ sar+b+ba satwa nā sar+b+ba a pa kā ra ra twaṃstan sar+b+bañdzaḥ shrī gh+raṃ badz+ra aṃ ku she nā kṛṣ+ya kṛṣ+ya/ ur+dhi da shi ga tā nā kṛṣ+ya kriṣ+ya/ de bzhin du rkang pa nyer bdun po'i mjug tu gā ta sogs sbyar te/ pūrba di shi/ dak+ṣi ṇa di shi/ ut+ta ra di shi/ pash+tsim di shi/ bā ya bya di shi/ ī sha na di shi/ nai ri t+ya di shi/ ag+ne di shi/ a dho di shi/ ā kā sha maṇ+ḍal/ bā yu maṇ+ḍal/ te dzo maṇ+ḍal/ to ya maṇ+ḍal/ pṛtha bī maṇ+ḍal/ kā ma dhā tu/ rū pa dhā tu/ a ru pa dhā tu/ kā ya dhā tu/ wāk+ka dhā tu/ tsit+ta dhā tu/ pañtsa gan+dha/ pañtsa dhū tu/ pañtsen+d+ri ya/ pañtsa bi ṣa ya/ pañtsa karmen+d+ri ya/ pañtsa karmen+d+ri ya bi ṣa ya/ sar+b+ba to ya tra ku tra tsita/ ma hāsh+ma shā ne badz+ra ag+ni dz+wa la ti bhū myāṃ ni pā ta ya ni pā ta ya/ badz+ra pā she na sar+b+ba bhū dze ṣu bhan+dha ya bhan+dha ya/ badz+ra shri kha le ya sar+b+ba pā de ṣu ni ro dha ya ni ro dha ya/ sar+b+ba sa twe ṣu kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta u pa dra ba kā ra ra taṃ staṃ ma hā kro dha badz+re ṇa tsūrna ya tsūrna ya/ badz+ra khaḍ+ge na ne krin+ta ya ni krin+ta ya/ badz+ra tri shū le na bhe da ya bhe da ya/ badz+ra kārti ke na ha na ha na badz+ra bā ṇe na bhin+da bhin+da/ badz+ra kī la ke na kī la kī la ya/ badz+ra muṅga re ṇa ā ko ṭa ya ā ko ṭa ya/ badz+ra tsakre ṇa ts+tshe da ya ts+tsha da ya/ badz+ra kun+te na bhin+da bhin+da/ badz+ra daṇ+ḍe na tā ḍa ya tā ḍa ya/ badz+ra par+ṣu na ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ sār+dha tri ko ṭi khaṇ+ḍaṃ kṛ twāsh+ma shā naṃ bhā myaṃ sar+b+ba bhū te bh+yo ba liṃ ku ru ku ru/

badz+ra ḍa ma ru ke na badz+ra ḍā ki nī rā bā ha ya bā ha ya/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī bh+yo mā ra kā yi kā nāṃ ru dhi raṃ ni be da ya ni be da ya/ pañtsāmṛ ta hā ri ṇī bh+yaḥpañtsāmṛ taṃ ni be da ya ni be da ya/ sar+b+ba badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa hi taḥsar+b+ba sa twa nā ma shān+ti kaṃ pauṣ+ṭi kaṃ rak+ṣā ba ra ṇa gup+tiṃ ku ru ku ru hū?m̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa rkang pa bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa ste/ bsnyen pa byed pa dang / sbyin sreg 'bum phrag bcu byas pas dngos grub thams cad 'grub la/ de+e nas snga ma bzlas pa tsam dang / phyi ma lan bdun bzlas pas bdud bgegs tshar gcod par gsungs so/ /gsum pa rjes la/ mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gtor ma/ gshegs gsol dang bzhi'i dang po ni/ sgrub thabs ltar mchod rdzas bsang sbyangs/ chu gnyis dang lha mo bcu gnyis dang / bdud rtsis mchod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed 'jigs par byed/ /dpa' bo gdul dka' 'dul ba po/ /dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /khams gsum rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /rje bo sna tshogs rdo rje 'dzin/ /khro bo'i rgyal po rnams kyi gtso/ /zhabs la srid gsum gyis bstod pa/ /rdo rje shugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ha ya ra wa la las skyes/ /rdo rje khro bo'i rgyal po che/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams rnams gnas nas/ /khang brtsegs nang bsrungs rnams la bstod/ /nga nya ṇa ma na las skyes/ /khro mo bcu yi ngo bo nyid/ /zad par grub pa rnam pa bcu/ /khang brtsegs phyi rol bsrung la bstod/ /gha dzha ḍha bha dha las skyes/ /byang sems bcu yi ngo bo nyid/ /phyogs bcu skyong ba rnam pa bcu/ ra gsum nang srung rnams la bstod/ /ga ja ḍa ba da las skyes/ /sems ma bcu yi ngo bo nyid/ /lha min 'jigs byed gza' rnams bcu/ /ra ba'i phyi rol srung mdzad bstod/ /kha tsha ṭha pha tha las skyes/ /sa 'og gnas pa gdug pa'i tshogs/ /ma lus 'dul mdzad klu rgyal bcu/ /ra ba lnga nang srung la bstod/

/ka tsa ṭa pa ta las skyes/ /rab gtum bcu yi ngo bo nyid/ /khams drug bdag nyid 'byung po bcu/ ra ba'i phyi rol srung la bstod/ /ces pas bstod do/ /gsum pa ni/ ji ltar 'byor ba'i gtor ma gcig gam/ drug gam/ bdun la sogs pa sgrub thabs ltar bsangs sbyangs la/ /stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zhu'i dbyibs can/ rgyal mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po me 'bar ba'i steng du/ āḥlas bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang ba'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ ra las thod pa dum bu gcig pa'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ a i ṛ u l̥ las/ dbus su khu ba/ shar du rkang / lhor khrag byang du dri chu/ nub tu bshang ba/ lī ū ṛ+ā ā+-i ā las/ rlung du glang po che'i sha/ dbang ldan du ba lang / srin por rta/ mer khyi/ dbus su mi'i sha rnams la sa bon de dag gis mtshan par bsams la/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis bskul ba'i rlung gis me spar te/ zhu ba'i dam tshig gi bdud rtsi nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog lta bur gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil du zla ba la/ oṃ bsams la gtor ma la bstan te/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra tsan+d+raḥ sar+b+ba dhar+m+māḥsu bi shud+dhaḥ swa bhā wa sar+b+ba dhar+m+mā na bi sho dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ oṃ las 'od zer 'phros bdud rtsi la phog pas/ mi gtsang ba'i dri ma sbyangs la lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du nyi ma la āḥbasams pa bstan te/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra sūr+ya sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥpra bo dha ka sar+b+ba d+dhār+m+ma na pra bo dha ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas āḥ las 'od 'phros pa phog pas/ bdud rtsi chags pa'i ro dang ldan par bsam mo/ /lag pa gnyis kha sbub pa'i snyim par sgra gcan la hūm̐ bsams pa bstan te/ oṃ hūm̐ badz+ra a na la sar+b+ba dhar+m+māḥ pra dī pa ka sar+b+ba dhar+m+man pra dī pa ya swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas bdud rtsi la phog pas/

mang por spel/ gzi brjid rab tu 'bar te kha dog dang dri ro phun sum tshogs par bsam/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas pa'i steng du/ dus me'i steng du hoḥbasam pa bstan te/ oṃ hoḥ sar+b+ba dhar+m+maḥ badz+ra a mṛ tra kā ra sar+b+ba dhar+m+man badz+ra a mṛ taṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas hoḥlas 'od 'phros pa'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug pa'i thim pas zag bcas kyi dri ma sbyangs nas/ zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam mo/ /de nas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgyas khro bo dang / gri gug gi phyag rgyas zad par dang / ral gri'i phyag rgyas phyogs skyong dang / rin po che'i phyag rgyas gza' dang / pad+ma'i phyag rgyas klu dang / 'khor lo'i phyag rgyas 'byung po rnams gtor ma'i mdun du spyan drangs nas gsol bar bsam zhing / gtso bo la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ shrī kā la tsakra badz+ra bhai ra ba sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ ba liṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ ak+ṣa taṃ/ da dā ma he/ te tsa ā ga t+ya sa pa ri wā ra/ shī gh+raṃ yi daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+nan+tu/ khā dan+tu/ pi wan+tu/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥsaṃ trit+tāḥsar+b+ba satwā nāṃ shān+tiṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ rak+ṣā ba ra ṇa k+ṣap+tiṃ kurban+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya ti swā hā/ zhes pas phul/ lha mo bcu gnyis dang bdud rtsis mchod la/ dus kyi 'khor lo thod pa can/ /sras bcas g.yog 'khor thams cad la/ /gtor ma dri dang me tog spos/ /sgron ma ma nyams 'bras bcas 'di/ /bdag gis 'bul gyi khyed rnams kyang / /'khor dang bcas pa myur gshegs nas/ /gtor ma 'di ni bsnams nas kyang / /gsol zhing btung ba mdzad nas su/ /yang dag mnyes pas sems can kun/ /zhi dang rgyas dang bsrung ba dang / /sba ba rnams ni mdzad nas kyang / /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin mdzod/ /ces pas bstod/ thams cad la oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho'i rjes la khro bo rnams la/ yuṣ+ṇi ṣa/ sum+bha ni sum+bha/ bigh+nān+ta ka

nī la daṇ+ḍa/ pradz+nyān+ta ka ṭāk+ki rā dza/ pad+mān+ta ka a tsa la/ ya mān+ta ka ma hā ba le bh+yaḥ sa pa ri sogs dang / rdo rje khro bo rgyal po'i bcu/ /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad la/ /gtor ma sogs sngar bzhin sbyar ba dang / zad par la/ ā kā sha/ bā yu/ te dza/ u da ka pṛtha bī sā hi te bh+yaḥ sogs dang / zad par grub pa rnam pa bcu/ /'khor sogs/ phyogs skyong la/ brah+ma/ biṣ+ṇu/ nai ri t+ya/ bā yu/ ya ma/ sa mu dra/ ī shwa ra/ in+d+ra/ yak+ṣe bh+yaḥ sogs/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnam pa bcu/ /'khor sogs/ gza' la/ rā hū/ kā la ag+ni/ tsan+d+ra/ sūr+ya/ bu dha/ maṅga la/ shu kra/ bri haspa ti/ ke tu/ sha ni bh+yaḥ sogs/ khyim gyi bdag po rnam pa bcu/ /'khor sogs/ klu la/ dza ya/ bi dza ya/ pad+ma/ karko ṭa/ bā su ki shaṃ kha pā la/ ku li ka a nan+ta/ tak+ṣa ka ma hā pad+me bh+yaḥ sogs/ sa 'og skyong mdzad rnam pa bcu/ /'khor sogs/ 'byung po la/ be tā ḍa/ bi kṛta mu kha/ shwa/ kā ka pū ka ra/ gṛ dh+ra/ byā gh+ra/ yu lū ka dzam+bu ka ga ru ḍa mu khe bh+yaḥ sogs/ lha min 'byung po rnam pa bcu/ /'khor sogs sbyar te gtor ma 'bul lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ yi ge k+ṣa dang / lag pa rgyab bstan pa'i se gol gyis gshegs su gsol te/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lor haṃ la khro bo/ gtsug tor du a la zad par/ dpral bar i la phyogs skyong / mgrin par ṛ la gza'/ snying gar u la klu/ lte bar l̥ la 'byung po'i 'khor lo gzhug par bya'o/ /dkyil chog gi dus su thun gsum la gtor ma byin pa'i tshul yang 'di nyid de/ 'di'i rjes la/ sa gzung ba la sogs pa bya'o/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo yi/ /sa gzhi yongs bzung dus nyid du/ /srung 'khor rgyas par bsgom pa'i tshul/ /rgyud 'grel bzhin du gsal bar bkod/ /ma rtogs log par rtog pa'i skyon/ /bla ma lhar bcas bzod mdzad cing / /dge bas bdag gzhan ma lus pa/ /mi mthun phyogs las rgyal gyur cig /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud thams cad 'joms pa zhes bya ba/
